standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, I'm Laidee. Welcome to the Warriors' Guild.

options.text: What are you doing out here?

steps.player: What are you doing out here?

steps.npc: I'm here to guard the Warrior's Guild and determine who's qualified to enter.

steps.player: So you're Ghommal's replacement?

steps.npc: That I am. Ghommal and I used to adventure together before we joined the Guild. It felt only right that I take over from him. It is... strange not having him around.

steps.player: I'm sorry for your loss. He was a great warrior.

steps.npc: And an even greater friend.

options.text: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.

steps.player: I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.

options.text: Could you explain what they are?

steps.player: Could you explain what they are?

steps.npc: Combat Achievements are a set of tasks for all adventurers to try and accomplish. They range from simple missions to kill various creatures, to challenges that will push you to your limits.
The purpose of these tasks is for you to grow and improve, experience all that Gielinor has to offer, and become stronger in the process.
Is this something that sounds interesting to you?

options.text: Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.

steps.player: Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.

steps.npc: Combat Achievements are broken down into six tiers: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite, Master and Grandmaster.
As you complete tasks, you'll earn points. Tasks in higher tiers give more points than easier tasks. Your rank depends on how many points you've earned.
Whenever new tasks are added to the list, there are more points available to earn, so the threshold needed for each rank will increase. Keep completing tasks to maintain your rank!

steps.text: This is the icon for the summary panel. Within it there is a section for Combat Achievements.
Clicking on the section will open the Combat Achievements interface, where you can browse tasks, bosses and rewards.
Some tasks will require numerous criteria to be completed, so make sure you read them carefully.

steps.npc: I'd recommend you go kill some monsters. Come back to me when you've completed a tier or two. I'll reward you for your efforts.

steps.player: Thanks a lot, I'll get going.
Not at the moment, no.

steps.player: Yes! It took quite a long time. Some of those tasks were extremely challenging, but I persevered and finished them all!

steps.npc: You have come very far. You have earned these rewards.
